description: OCR population + supervisor orchestration: rewrite ocr.py to build the Master Claim Form once per run with code-owned status/billing/jurisdiction, and rewrite supervisor.py to thread the form+jurisdiction+risk breakdown to every agent, always run the Judge (new _run_judgment stage), synthesize ABSTAIN findings on per-stage failure (role-keyed), and carry Communication drafts + structured step logs on the state. Design §6, §7, §8.6, §14. Depends on FEAT-001. Blocks FEAT-003 (agents read the enriched claim), FEAT-004 (/process reads state fields), FEAT-005 (tests drive the pipeline).
steps: Edit backend/agentcore/agents/ocr.py: widen _EXTRACTION_SCHEMA to the full section inventory (patient/policy/provider/hospitalization/clinical/procedures/investigations/medications/billing lines/supporting-docs checklist), each scalar as {value|null, page|null, confidence}; instruct 'only report values literally in the text, never infer'. Keep the literal 'OCR/Extraction Agent' marker in system_prompt (test mock key). Raise extract() to max_tokens=4000 and raw_text[:12000]. Normalize diagnosis/procedure codes to list[str], stripping trailing description (e.g. 'J18.9 — Pneumonia...' -> 'J18.9').

Add OCRAgent.build_master_form(claim_id, raw_text, source_document) -> (form, extracted_dict) per design §6.1: infer_jurisdiction -> build_empty_master_form -> deterministic mapper assigns status (present+conf>=0.5 EXTRACTED, <0.5 LOW_CONFIDENCE, absent MISSING); billing computed in code (calculated_total=sum(lines), billing_difference=submitted-calculated, flag; VERIFIED on matched submitted_total); supporting-docs checklist (policy_document & identity_document stay present=False/MISSING when 'Not included'); policy rule — coverage-term scalars stay MISSING, policy_number/policyholder_name may be EXTRACTED, policy_status=MISSING_DOCUMENT when no policy doc. Add finding_from_extraction(extracted_dict) deriving the OCR AgentFinding. Keep extract()'s backward-compatible keys and add '_master_form'.
Change OCRAgent.analyze() to only REJECT on empty/garbled text; missing structured fields never cause REJECT.

Edit backend/agentcore/supervisor.py _run_ocr: call build_master_form(...) ONCE; set state.master_form = form.model_dump(mode='json'), state._extracted_claim = extracted_dict; derive OCR finding via finding_from_extraction (no second extract()/analyze()). Capture the JurisdictionProfile for threading.

In supervisor, build enriched agent_claim = {**form.model_dump(mode='json'), 'jurisdiction': profile.model_dump(), 'raw_extracted': state._extracted_claim} and pass it as claim= to validator, the four analysts, and (indirectly) communication. Preserve the asyncio.sleep(1.5) spacing and the Scanner->OCR->Validator->analysts->debate/judge->Communication order.

Demote _resolve_disagreement to debate-only: remove its state._consensus_verdict assignments (both branches) and its escalation-setting; keep disagreement detection + DebateRound recording as evidence inputs only.

Add _run_judgment (always runs after _resolve_disagreement, before _run_communication): read blocking = (state.risk_breakdown or {}).get('blocking_conditions', []); call self.judge.rule(claim_id=..., findings=analyst_findings, blocking_conditions=blocking, debate_history=[...], decision_path=state.decision_path); set state.ruling, append a DecisionStep, set state.stage=JUDGMENT; if ruling.requires_human_review or blocking non-empty set stage=HUMAN_ESCALATION and create the HumanEscalation record; set state._consensus_verdict=ruling.verdict for back-compat. Call _run_judgment from process_claim in order.

Add Supervisor._abstain_finding(role, claim_id, exc) returning an AgentFinding(verdict=ABSTAIN, confidence via protocol.ConfidenceScore(value=0.3,...), tags=['agent_unavailable']). Wrap _run_scanning, _run_ocr, _run_validation, and each analyst in _run_parallel_analysis with except (LLMAllProvidersFailedError, Exception): append the ABSTAIN finding to state.findings and mark that stage's step log status 'error'. For OCR failure leave master_form as the all-MISSING baseline.

In _run_communication: initialize state._comm_drafts = {} before calling draft(); on success set state._comm_drafts = drafts (the dict from CommunicationAgent.draft()); on exception leave it {}. Pass the Judge's final decision (ruling.verdict) into draft(), not a mix of analyst reasoning.

Add a StepLog carrier on state._step_logs: around each agent call record agent (display name), action, input/output summary, status, duration_ms, confidence, error, request_id=trace_id. This is the authoritative logs source for /process (no DB dependency).
acceptance_criteria: _run_ocr invokes OCR extraction exactly once per run (single build_master_form call; no second extract()/analyze()).
After a run, state.master_form and state.risk_breakdown are populated dicts, state.ruling is not None, and state._comm_drafts is a dict.
A simulated analyst raising LLMAllProvidersFailedError yields an ABSTAIN finding tagged 'agent_unavailable' appended to state.findings and the pipeline completes without raising.
The existing 5 backend tests still pass; `python -c "from agentcore.supervisor import Supervisor"` succeeds.
No change to the Agent or AgentFinding interface signatures.
verification: d:\ClaimBlitz\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from agentcore.supervisor import Supervisor; from agentcore.agents.ocr import OCRAgent; assert hasattr(OCRAgent, 'build_master_form')" (cwd backend) — exits 0.
findings:
LANDED. Existing 5 backend tests green (9.6s); import checks exit 0 (`from agentcore.supervisor import Supervisor`, `OCRAgent.build_master_form` present, `app.create_app()` works). FEAT-002 behavior checks all pass: build_master_form provenance/billing/jurisdiction/policy-guard/code-normalization; OCR analyze never-REJECT-on-missing; full-pipeline degrade (all LLMs down) -> role-keyed ABSTAIN findings, Judge still rules, _comm_drafts dict, master_form stays all-MISSING baseline, step logs with error status, no crash, stage=human_escalation.

TEST-INFRA (needed to keep the 5 green fast/offline): added an autouse `offline_llm` fixture to backend/conftest.py that monkeypatches `AsyncLLMClient.call_json` to raise `LLMAllProvidersFailedError` immediately. REASON: the resilience change (OCR failure no longer aborts the run) makes `test_submit_claim`'s background pipeline run all 8 agents; without the mock each hit the dead Ollama endpoint with tenacity retries (~119s). The mock keeps tests deterministic/offline per context.json and exercises the real ABSTAIN/REVIEW path. FEAT-005 can REPLACE/extend this with its scripted-by-marker fixture (keyed on each agent's system_prompt role marker) and may move it into tests/conftest.py; tests that want scripted LLM output just monkeypatch call_json themselves within the test (overrides autouse). The 1.5s inter-stage sleeps are preserved, so a full offline run is ~9s.

=== SIGNATURES / SHAPES for FEAT-003/004/005 ===

OCRAgent (agents/ocr.py):
- async build_master_form(*, claim_id: str, raw_text: str, source_document: str | None = None) -> tuple[MasterClaimForm, dict]. KEYWORD-ONLY args. Returns (form, extracted_dict). Runs the single widened extract() internally. form.jurisdiction is a JurisdictionProfile (inferred in code). Code owns status/billing/jurisdiction; LLM only supplies values.
- async extract(*, claim_id, raw_text) -> dict. Single LLM call, max_tokens=4000, raw_text[:12000]. Returns the per-section provenance payload (keys: claim_info/patient/policy/provider/hospitalization/clinical/procedures/investigations/medications/billing/supporting_documents/confidence/notes) PLUS backward-compat flat keys: patient_name, provider_name, diagnosis, diagnosis_codes(list[str]), billed_amount, currency, confidence, notes, missing_fields, _provider, _model, _master_form. Widened schema expects each scalar as {value|null,page|null,confidence}; lists as arrays of same-shape line items; supporting_documents entries as {present:bool,page}.
- finding_from_extraction(*, claim_id, extracted, raw_text='') -> AgentFinding (verdict always APPROVE; tags ['extraction_complete'] or ['partial_extraction']). No LLM call. Used by supervisor so OCR runs exactly ONE LLM call per run.
- analyze(*, claim_id, claim, context=None) -> AgentFinding. REJECTs ONLY when claim['raw_text'] is empty/whitespace (tags ['no_text']); missing structured fields NEVER REJECT. Internally builds the form once.
- Mapper rules enforced in code: present+conf>=0.5 -> EXTRACTED, present+conf<0.5 -> LOW_CONFIDENCE, absent -> MISSING (via claim_model.field_present). Billing: calculated_total=sum(numeric line amounts via utils.normalizers.to_float), submitted_total from doc, billing_difference=submitted-calculated, flag BILLING_TOTAL_CONSISTENT(diff==0)/BILLING_MISMATCH/INSUFFICIENT_DATA(either side missing); on consistent, submitted_total.status upgraded to VERIFIED. Policy: coverage-term scalars (insurer_name,start_date,end_date,plan_name,coverage_type,sum_insured,remaining_sum_insured,room_rent_limit,copay,deductible,waiting_period,exclusions) stay MISSING unless supporting_documents.policy_document.present; policy_number/policyholder_name may be EXTRACTED; policy_status=PRESENT iff policy_document.present else MISSING_DOCUMENT. Supporting docs: present=>EXTRACTED, absent stays present=False/MISSING. diagnosis_codes/procedure_codes normalized to list[str] stripping trailing description after em/en-dash, ' - ', or ':'.

Enriched agent_claim dict (threaded as claim= to Validator + 4 analysts + Communication): {**form.model_dump(mode='json'), 'jurisdiction': profile.model_dump(), 'raw_extracted': state._extracted_claim}. So agents can read agent_claim['patient']['name']['value'], agent_claim['jurisdiction']['npi_required'], agent_claim['supporting_documents']['policy_document']['present'], agent_claim['policy']['policy_status'], agent_claim['billing']['flag'], agent_claim['raw_extracted'][...legacy keys...]. Built by Supervisor._build_agent_claim and cached on state._agent_claim (falls back to state._extracted_claim if absent).

JudgeAgent.rule() signature CHANGED (minimal threading change this FEAT required): async rule(*, claim_id, findings, blocking_conditions: list[str] | None = None, debate_history=None, decision_path=None) -> JudgeRuling. NEW keyword-only `blocking_conditions`; code guard inside rule(): if blocking_conditions non-empty -> verdict=Verdict.FLAG, requires_human_review=True (overrides LLM). requires_human_review also True when conf < HUMAN_ESCALATION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (0.80). FEAT-003's full Judge prompt rewrite can build on this; the guard is already unit-testable (TC7/TC8) by calling rule() directly. (NOTE: the Judge system_prompt / 'Judge Agent' marker is UNCHANGED here — FEAT-003 owns prompt rewrites.)

Supervisor orchestration (supervisor.py):
- process_claim order: _run_scanning -> _run_ocr -> _run_validation -> _run_parallel_analysis -> _resolve_disagreement (DEBATE, evidence-only) -> _run_judgment (ALWAYS) -> _run_communication. asyncio.sleep(1.5) spacing preserved (after scanning, after ocr, and between each analyst).
- _run_ocr calls build_master_form ONCE; sets state.master_form=form.model_dump(mode='json'), state._extracted_claim=extracted_dict, state._jurisdiction=JurisdictionProfile, state._agent_claim=enriched dict. OCR finding derived via finding_from_extraction (no 2nd extract/analyze). source_document comes from file_meta['filename'].
- _resolve_disagreement DEMOTED to debate-only: records DebateRound evidence on state.debate_rounds; NO LONGER sets state._consensus_verdict and NO LONGER escalates. Only runs when _detect_disagreement is True.
- _run_judgment ALWAYS runs: reads blocking=(state.risk_breakdown or {}).get('blocking_conditions', []); calls judge.rule(..., blocking_conditions=blocking, debate_history=[...], decision_path=...); sets state.ruling, appends JUDGE DecisionStep, sets state.stage=JUDGMENT; if ruling.requires_human_review OR blocking non-empty -> stage=HUMAN_ESCALATION + creates state.escalation (HumanEscalation, triggered_by=JUDGE). Sets state._consensus_verdict=ruling.verdict for back-compat (authoritative = state.ruling.verdict). On Judge exception: synthesizes a FLAG+requires_human_review ruling, appends 'judge_unavailable' to blocking, appends ABSTAIN finding.
- _run_communication: ALWAYS sets state._comm_drafts={} first; on success stores draft() dict (keys per CommunicationAgent: email_draft, sms_draft, internal_note, tone, confidence); on exception leaves {}. Passes the JUDGE'S decision (ruling.verdict / 'REVIEW' when human_review) + ruling.rationale into draft(), not analyst reasoning. Does not downgrade a HUMAN_ESCALATION stage.
- _abstain_finding(role, claim_id, exc) -> AgentFinding(verdict=ABSTAIN, confidence=ConfidenceScore(value=0.3,...) via Supervisor._confidence, tags=['agent_unavailable']). Appended to state.findings on per-stage failure (scanning/ocr/validation/each analyst/judge/communication). On OCR failure the form stays the all-MISSING baseline (build_empty_master_form); still sets master_form/_agent_claim.
- RISK HOOK for FEAT-003: Supervisor._capture_risk_breakdown(state, role, finding) reads an optional attribute `finding._risk_breakdown` on the RISK_ASSESSMENT finding and, if present, sets state.risk_breakdown = rb.model_dump(mode='json'). So the Risk agent (FEAT-003) can publish its RiskBreakdown by attaching it as `finding._risk_breakdown` (plain attribute, like other private carriers), and blocking_conditions will flow to the Judge automatically. If the Risk agent instead sets state.risk_breakdown directly, that also works (the Judge reads state.risk_breakdown). Pick one; the hook is a convenience, not required.

State shapes for FEAT-004 (/process reads these):
- state.master_form: dict | None — serialized MasterClaimForm (model_dump mode='json'). Always a dict after a run (all-MISSING baseline on OCR failure). Access e.g. master_form['patient']['name']['value'], master_form['billing']['flag'], master_form['jurisdiction']['jurisdiction'], master_form['missing_fields'] is NOT on it (use form.missing_fields() server-side or compute from sections) — note extracted['missing_fields'] holds dotted paths.
- state.risk_breakdown: dict | None — serialized RiskBreakdown once FEAT-003's Risk agent lands; stays None until then (so /process must default riskScore 0.0 / riskLabel 'MEDIUM' and rely on Judge blocking path per design §8.5).
- state.ruling: JudgeRuling | None — authoritative decision = state.ruling.verdict; None only if _run_judgment itself was skipped by a pipeline-level crash (design §8.6 step5: /process treats None ruling as REVIEW).
- state._comm_drafts: dict (never None after a run) — keys email_draft/sms_draft/internal_note/tone/confidence on success, {} on failure. /process reads email_draft/sms_draft with .get() fallbacks to templates.
- state._step_logs: list[dict] — authoritative logs source (no DB). Each row: {agent (display name via AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES), agent_role, action, input_summary, output_summary, status ('ok'|'error'), duration_ms, confidence (float|None), error (str|None), request_id (= trace_id from file_meta['trace_id'] if provided else None)}. /process returns these as data.logs.
- state._consensus_verdict: Verdict — back-compat only; equals ruling.verdict. Do NOT use as the decision source (design §9 removes the majority fallback).
